dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the mid-lateral flank exhibit sharp gradient transitions from the dark exterior pelt to high-intensity light-colored perimeters; these annuli are irregularly circular with serrated outer edges and enclose darker interior regions.

dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent macro-annuli located on the central lateral flank form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest side extending toward the posterior region of the animal.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct circumferential indentation or deep tissue fold is visible at the junction of the head and neck, creating a visible break in the smooth dorsal-lateral contour.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral flipper displays five highly distinct, elongated dark digits with clear interdigital separation and high contrast against the adjacent light-patterned fur.
